dual_relevance: Food industry: enzymatic browning of fresh-cut fruits/vegetables (apple, potato, avocado)
Cosmetics: skin hyperpigmentation, melasma, age spots (human tyrosinase)
section_1_literature_framing.mechanism: Type-3 binuclear copper enzyme. CuA (His61, His85, His94) and CuB (His259, His263, His296) activate molecular O2, catalyze ortho-hydroxylation of monophenols (monophenolase) and oxidation of o-diphenols to o-quinones (diphenolase). Quinones polymerize to melanin. Inhibition strategies: (1) copper chelation, (2) substrate mimicry, (3) allosteric blockade.

key_references.citation: Zolghadri et al. (2019) J Enzyme Inhib Med Chem 34:279. doi:10.1080/14756366.2018.1543420
Chang (2009) J Agric Food Chem 57:2521. doi:10.1021/jf800798n
key_references.relevance: Browning mechanism and kojic acid inhibition

design_principles: Maintain two oxygen donors within 2.5-3.5 A to chelate the binuclear Cu center
Phenolic OH groups mimic the substrate L-DOPA for competitive inhibition
Structural analogs explore electronic (F, Cl, NO2) and steric (Me, tBu, iPr) effects
Lipinski Rule of Five compliance targeted for potential oral/topical application
Novel scaffold NOV005 introduces dual-mode chelation (enol-O + hydroxamic acid)
section_2_design_rationale.boltz2_note: Boltz-2 binding affinity prediction was NOT run — no model weights found in models/ directory. All affinity data from AutoDock Vina only.

section_3_validation_analysis.receptor_prep: Chain A protein only; HETATM stripped; AD4 atom types assigned; Gasteiger charges zeroed

ranked_candidates.name: Hydroxamic acid-tropolone hybrid
ranked_candidates.rationale: Adds hydroxamic acid arm to tropolone; dual chelation mode (enol-O + hydroxamate) targeting both Cu ions simultaneously

ranked_candidates.name: Beta-Thujaplicin
ranked_candidates.rationale: Natural tropolone derivative from Western red cedar; known copper chelator with antimicrobial activity

ranked_candidates.name: 3-Methyltropolone
ranked_candidates.rationale: Methyl at C3 adjacent to O=C; exploits hydrophobic space seen with tropolone pose

ranked_candidates.name: 3-Chlorotropolone
ranked_candidates.rationale: Halogen at C3 tests H-bond acceptor capacity vs steric clash in tight pocket

ranked_candidates.name: 4-Chlororesorcinol
ranked_candidates.rationale: Meta-diol + para-Cl: explores effect of diol positioning on Cu coordination geometry

ranked_candidates.name: Arbutin
cosmetic_notes: Arbutin: allowed in EU cosmetics; slow hydrolysis to hydroquinone flagged

ranked_candidates.name: 5-Methylkojic acid
ranked_candidates.rationale: Methyl group explores hydrophobic pocket near CuA (PHE90, LEU89)

ranked_candidates.name: Mimosine
ranked_candidates.rationale: Plant amino acid with hydroxypyridinone chelating group; strong Cu binder different from catechol

ranked_candidates.name: Caffeic acid
ranked_candidates.rationale: Catechol + alpha,beta-unsaturated acid; known competitive inhibitor; provides extended chelation arm

ranked_candidates.name: 5-Chlorokojic acid
ranked_candidates.rationale: Cl provides stronger steric effect than F; tests halogen tolerance at Cu site

ranked_candidates.name: 4-Nitrotropolone
ranked_candidates.rationale: Strong EWG at C4 alters pi-electron density of chelating enol; toxicophore flag expected
cosmetic_notes: Nitro aromatic: potential mutagenicity risk (Ames test concern)

ranked_candidates.name: 5-Fluorokojic acid
ranked_candidates.rationale: Electron-withdrawing F at C5 increases electrophilicity of carbonyl, potentially tightening Cu chelation

ranked_candidates.name: 4-Hydroxybenzaldehyde
ranked_candidates.rationale: Simple phenolic aldehyde; Schiff-base former that may covalently cap active-site Lys

ranked_candidates.name: 4-Methoxyphenol
ranked_candidates.rationale: Known partial tyrosinase inhibitor; methoxy vs hydroxyl tests H-bond donor requirement

ranked_candidates.name: 4-tert-Butylcatechol
ranked_candidates.rationale: Bulky tBu fills hydrophobic sub-pocket (TRP93, PHE292); commercial antioxidant

ranked_candidates.name: Hydroquinone
cosmetic_notes: Hydroquinone/catechol: EU cosmetics directive restricts >1% concentration

ranked_candidates.name: Oxyresveratrol
ranked_candidates.rationale: Natural stilbene with two catechol-like OH pairs; potent PPO inhibitor in literature (IC50 ~1 uM); included as novel positive control

ranked_candidates.name: 4-Fluorocatechol
ranked_candidates.rationale: Fluorine bioisostere of OH; tests whether para-F maintains inhibition

ranked_candidates.name: Catechol
ranked_candidates.rationale: Ortho-diol: strong Cu chelator; substrate-like but inhibitory at high concentration
cosmetic_notes: Hydroquinone/catechol: EU cosmetics directive restricts >1% concentration

ranked_candidates.name: Kojic acid methyl ester
ranked_candidates.rationale: Esterification of hydroxymethyl reduces HBD count (improves logP) while probing pocket volume

novelty_claims: NOV005 (Hydroxamic acid-tropolone hybrid): dual Cu-chelation mode not previously reported for this scaffold
Systematic halogen scan (F, Cl) around tropolone C3 position unexplored in published literature
Beta-thujaplicin (natural tropolone) screened against 2Y9X structure for first time in this pipeline
limitations: Docking uses zero-charge Gasteiger approximation for receptor; Vina scores carry ~1-2 kcal/mol uncertainty
Cu2+ coordination not modeled by standard Vina force field (metalloprotein docking limitation)
No MD simulation performed — binding poses not equilibrated
ProTox/SwissADME values require manual submission (no API); dossier safety section incomplete until done
Boltz-2 binding prediction not run (no weights on disk) — Vina is sole binding metric
Ellagic acid (REF005) excluded: RDKit SMILES parse failure (aromatic form); would require SMILES standardization
No in vitro or in vivo validation — computational predictions only
